title: AesBiasBench: Evaluating Bias and Alignment in Multimodal Language Models for Personalized Image Aesthetic Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image aesthetic and emotional judgment tasks by conditioning prompts on male versus female identities and measuring statistical deviations using Identity Frequency Disparity (IFD), Normalized Representation Disparity (NRD), and Aesthetic Alignment Score (AAS).
Modifying prompts to include specific age groups (e.g., 18-21, 22-25) and assessing disparities in the model's aesthetic and emotional predictions across these groups using IFD, NRD, and AAS.

Prompting models with distinct educational backgrounds (e.g., junior high, university) and computing IFD, NRD, and AAS to measure representational disparities and preference alignments in aesthetic assessments.

Comparing model aesthetic assessments across different geographic regions (e.g., Europe, Oceania) on the LAPIS dataset to compute representation disparities (NRD) and aesthetic alignment scores (AAS).
